title: Q-RES-powers-1973-P2: Control without reading the result (measured 0.006, target >= 0.25)
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** research pass: powers-1973 finding P2 is not-met (measured 0.006)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation research --probe powers-1973:P2
**Prediction:** second_loop_kept_share >= 0.25 within 72 h
**Out of scope:** editing the study, its target or the paper to match the code; the measurement is changed only by changing the mechanism
**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation research --probe powers-1973:P2`
**Status:** open

Concern: Control without reading the result. The study: Output that is never compared with the result is not control. The second loop judges its own steps and keeps only those that brought the variable back in limits.

Mechanisms that should answer it: SECOND-LOOP-2 (foundation/ultrastability.py); GOALS-1 (seed/worker/src/goals.js).

Metric: share of second-order steps that brought the variable back inside its limits and were kept, target >= 0.25. Improve the mechanism (or add one) until the probe passes; the white paper at /research updates itself from the same measurement.
